name: Respecting Authorities
overview: Scripture teaches that all authorities are established by God, who controls the rise and fall of rulers and grants wisdom to leaders, as seen in Daniel 2:21. Believers are called to submit to governing powers because they are ordained by God (Romans 13:1) and to render respect and honor where it is due (Romans 13:7). This principle extends to family relationships, where children are instructed to obey their parents, and fathers are charged with nurturing their children in the Lord (Ephesians 6:1, 4). Additionally, believers are reminded to obey magistrates and be ready for good works (Titus 3:1), reflecting a Christ-centered approach to respecting authority in all spheres of life.
